shots.text: Beyond the Crack, nothing is the right way up.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Through the Crack: the Outer Hollow, a black sky with a black sun and a crown-shaped gap. Hanging upside down beneath it, a vast fortress.

shots.text: Nhal Vorath. He built it out of everything his Unbound tore from our world. I am told the walls of Kethra are in it. And Vitrea. And our Dawn Gate.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Close on the citadel walls: recognisable pieces of fallen cities: glass towers, a frozen ship, uprooted trees, broken Spirewright towers, and the Dawn Gate set as a tooth in an enormous mouth.

shots.text: This is my world. You are standing in it. That is a mistake you will not make twice.
shots.speaker: vael_orrun
shots.art_note: The black sun's corona flaring; every colour on screen drains to grey for a moment.

shots.text:
Then it's a good thing we only need to make it once. Spirewright... for the first time in this war, we are not holding the road.

We are taking it.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin, lantern-pole raised, at the head of the army, the Gatemaw ahead.
